subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Is a single fixed 300-second status-only finalization grace the intended setup contract for legitimate Ollama verification and manifest-writing phases?
rationale: The upstream stream contract confirms status-only finalization exists but does not define its maximum duration, so source review cannot determine whether failing after this grace is an acceptable user-visible setup failure.

options.title: Require proof and accept the grace
options.body: Request exact-head native-loopback or local-Ollama proof, then merge if the responsible owner accepts 300 seconds as the intended maximum finalization budget.

options.title: Use a different finalization policy
options.body: Keep semantic completed-progress detection but revise the grace behavior if the owner expects valid finalization to exceed 300 seconds.

recommendation.title: Require proof and accept the grace
recommendation.body: Request exact-head native-loopback or local-Ollama proof, then merge if the responsible owner accepts 300 seconds as the intended maximum finalization budget.

likelyOwner.reason: Explicitly routed into this PR's revision discussion and best positioned among the available evidence to resolve the setup-timeout policy.
